details.name: Catcher
details.quote: Catcher, Op Team Z7. My role is giving the team cover and logistics support. I specialize in defensive operations and I'm good with the blade... And I hope I'll be an effective addition to your team.
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Tool Assembly: Weapon Maintenance Every weapon wielded by Catcher always survives well beyond their average field life expectancy.
details.exp2d: Cooking: Battlefield Cuisine "He only makes three things — roast fowl, tater roast, and field soup. But nobody ever gets tired of it."
details.hb1d: Lifestyle: Meticulous Home Economist Having witnessed his meticulous dedication to cooking, cleaning, and home appliance repairs, a fellow Endfielder awarded Catcher with this title — omni-butler.
details.hb2d: Sports: Perpetual Training Routine The first PT exercise he learned at camp was 30 squats per day. He kept at it for 1946 days.
details.matstats: Sundered Prince, Seeker of Dark Lung }}
